blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Philippine literature feted its finest voices as 60 standout writers received honors during the 76th Carlos Palanca Memorial Awards for Literature on Tuesday in Makati City. Philippine Daily Inquirer executive editor Voltaire Contreras was among the 63 judges of this year’s Palanca awards. Contreras, who also judged submissions in 2025, evaluated entries
